data.name: Krutik
data.gender_notes: Krutik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'krut', meaning 'to do', 'to make' or 'to create'. The name Krutik signifies one who is skillful, dexterous, clever and capable. It is a revered name for a boy in Hindu tradition. The name Krutik carries the meaning “Skillful, dexterous, clever” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Krutik usually hope their child will grow to embody skillful, dexterous, clever and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the power to create and make a difference.
data.etymology: Krutik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Skillful, dexterous, clever.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Krutik total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Krutik holds immense prestige and respect in Hindu culture, symbolizing the qualities of intelligence, creativity and skillfulness. A child bearing this name is often viewed as a prodigy, destined for greatness and achievement in various fields. This image of an accomplished, forward-thinking individual has been a source of pride for parents and family members, often leading to high expectations, nurturing of talent and a drive for excellence.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Krutik encapsulates the essence of being a co-creator with the divine. The implication is that one's actions in the physical world can add to the very tapestry of creation and can reap significant consequences. It encourages an individual to consider every action as one that is sustained and endorsed by the divine, creating an opportunity for the cultivation of positive karma and the manifestation of one's potential. The responsibility that comes with this name to make the world a better place through thoughtful actions can serve as a guiding principle for a spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Krutik: One who shapes or molds reality with divine grace and actions. Embodiment of creative energy and purposeful existence.
